title: Watch an ARM import walkthrough beside the instructions.
description: Import ARM now includes a silent 30-second video with numbered callouts, showing Azure Portal export steps and the Studio import workflow.

before.caption: Import ARM showed written instructions only

after.caption: Watch the silent ARM walkthrough beside the instructions

note: The file picker still opens immediately. The local video plays only when you press Play, includes fullscreen controls, and pauses when importing or closing the dialog. Callouts are in English.
